ModMetaData.name: mulld Priorities
ModMetaData.author: mulld
ModMetaData.description:
Colony needs. Useful work. Your approval.
FEATURES Read the colony: food, care and harvest indicators. Set the rules: Balanced, Clean, Harvest, Haul or your own preset. Approve the work: preview proposed priorities in the grid, then Apply.
HOW TO OPEN Enable Harmony and mulld Priorities, then restart RimWorld. Load a colony, open Work, and click the mulld Priorities control above the grid to expand the panel.
The eye previews changes. The disk saves or overwrites a custom preset.
Keep control with primary workers, backups, locks, exclusions and undo. Daily automation and diagnostics are optional and off by default.
REQUIREMENTS RimWorld 1.7 and Harmony (load Harmony first). Standard Off / 1–4 priorities.
